title: Identity morphism of a fine saturated log scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian fine saturated log scheme, with log morphisms as in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. Its identity log morphism $\operatorname{id}_X:X\to X$ has the identity underlying scheme morphism. For etale objects $V\to X$, $W\to X$ and a morphism $k:V\to W$ over $X$, its relative log-section map $M_X(W)\to M_X(V)$ is the restriction homomorphism along $k$. Thus the identity fixes the scheme and log structure, rather than being an arbitrary log endomorphism with identity scheme map.
